name: Gores Holdings X Inc. Units
summary: Gores Holdings X, Inc. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), established without any prior business operations. Its core mandate is to identify and then complete a significant business combination, which could involve a merger, a capital stock exchange, an asset acquisition, a stock purchase, a reorganization, or a comparable strategic transaction with one or more existing businesses. This organization was founded on June 26, 2023, and maintains its principal office in Boulder, Colorado.
